purpose: Conservative integer-raster registration compatibility only; never native style/geometry equality

allowed: finite lossless IEEE754 binary64 JSON roundtrip
explicitly declared native binary32/integer losslessly promoted to that representation

projection.arithmetic: Exact rational values of decoded native numbers and independently verified map parameters; no floating floor/ceil after cancellation
requirements: fixed native coordinate origin and native-to-PNG provenance
actual viewport crop maps to integral PNG rectangle W x H
same W/H/color representation for the pair
raw native anchor strictly inside native viewport; no tolerant flag substitution
projection.not_source_of_truth: A guessed image_frame, fitted density or viewport selected to improve pixel agreement

cell_enclosure.meaning: Conservative pixel-boundary enclosure of the exact recorded scalar, not measurement-error tolerance

pair_compatibility.motion: integer (0,-D), 0 < D < H for progressing down-link
pair_compatibility.predicate: For every eligible common identity, one common positive pixel rectangle exists in both candidate sets after translation; satisfy all edge displacement ranges AND direct sizes. Jointly preserve native order and independent non-overlapping witness boxes.
pair_compatibility.witnesses: At least two distinct actual leaves with disjoint raw/native and selected raster vertical support; no parent-child/coincident wrapper pairs

raster_selection.D: Unique integer satisfying all native constraints AND exact complete-width overlap RGBA equality
raster_selection.search: Lossless exact pixel search over geometry-admissible integer candidates; rounding a float is never approval

claim_limit: Pixel-compatible registration does not prove exact native rectangle equality or waive any raw geometry/design assertion. Closed-domain, epochs and actual boundaries still required.
